free_tier.stated: A free trial is attached to every term: 30 days on the 12-month plan, 14 days on the 6-month prepaid plan and 14 days on the 1-month plan, all reached through a billing redirect.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, approximately 750 KB by convention, so 1 TiB of monthly transfer corresponds to roughly 1.4 million article fetches
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: The vendor homepage states 'Over 5 Years of Binaries'; the r/usenet map records 550+ days for binaries and 5,800+ days for text on the same backbone. The conservative figure is recorded.

egress.terms: Unlimited Transfer and Unlimited Speed, 100 connections, SSL, VyprVPN included

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563. No HTTP or object API exists for the download path, which is driven through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav.
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Its only stacking value is the bundled VyprVPN; the 550-day binary spool makes it a poor primary beside any Omicron or Abavia plan.

limits.value: 550+ days for binaries against 5,800+ days for text, reported; the vendor states over 5 years of binaries

limits_note: Black Friday 2026: 1 year $4.65/mo billed $56.00 for the first year, then $8.33/mo; 6 months $9.17/mo; 1 month $9.99/mo. All terms include VyprVPN. The trial links point at order.giganews.com/signup/billing_redirect.html, which is a payment step.
binding_note: Binary depth is the constraint, not volume: unlimited transfer at 100 connections never runs out, but a 550-day binary spool cannot retrieve a 2019 post however much bandwidth is left.

identity_cost.detail: The trial is entered through a billing redirect, so a payment method is captured at the start. The vendor's own signup page describes the trial as starting from that billing step.

reliability_note: Own US and NL infrastructure on AS30094. The vendor states over 5 years of binary retention; the community map records 550 days, a large gap between vendor and mapped figures.
confidence_note: Prices, connections and the trial length are vendor-stated and read today. Binary retention is third-party and contradicts the vendor's number, so the record keeps 550 days and sits at the reported rung.

evidence.proved: 1 Year $8.33/mo billed yearly at $100.00; 6 Months $9.17/mo; 1 Month $9.99/mo; '+ 14 days free trial' and '+ 3 days free trial'; 100 connections; unlimited transfer
